high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a page from a document or article. The text discusses a critical problem faced by sensory systems, specifically how self-generated signals (such as motion) can significantly alter sensory input, overshadowing more important externally generated signals. To address this issue, the text suggests that an efference copy (a copy of motor commands) is sent to sensory areas. This allows for the prediction and subtraction of the effect of self-generated signals from the sensory signal, thereby isolating only the externally generated signals.
